hero.intro: I'm Wensheng Chen; I go by Wilson. I'm CTO at The Juicy Crab, and I also run [bestpos.io](https://bestpos.io), [kloudeats.com](https://kloudeats.com), and a growing set of AI-powered developer tool experiments.
paragraphs: I am currently exploring how to make agents less generic and more useful: pressure-test ideas before code, turn requirements into durable reference files, and encode context and voice so the output reflects the actual project.

That work keeps pulling me toward static-first architecture, build-time validation, and skill-driven workflows. I care about compressing the distance between intention and execution without adding another layer of process for its own sake.

currentFocus.title: Current Focus & Problems
currentFocus.description: What I'm obsessed with now and the problems I believe matter.
paragraphs: The problem I keep returning to is that software still loses context at the moment it matters. Ideas get coded before they are challenged, specs drift from reality, and agents fill the gaps with plausible defaults that sound right but miss the point.

I believe the next advantage comes from clearer articulation and better operating environments: sharper requirements, explicit constraints, reusable skills, and systems that fail early instead of shipping ambiguity downstream.
